current. Happening or true now.
plan. A set of steps you decide on to reach something.
achieve. To reach a goal by working hard.
hope. A feeling that you want something good to happen.
earn. To get money for the work you do.
dream. Something you really want to do or be one day.
nightmare. A scary or very bad dream.
fantasy. An imagined story or world that is not real.
déjà vu. The feeling that you have lived this moment before.
sleepwalking. Walking around while you are asleep.
